title: Gold and Silver ALERT: The Derivatives Fight That Never Really Ended
speaker: Jeffrey Christian

macro_themes.view: 10-year breaking above 5% spooked all asset markets via valuation models; rates are rising for bad reasons (deficits, oil, weakness), though still historically low.
Midterms and expected legal challenges will produce a hostile, ineffectual government and erode respect for policymakers, ultimately positive for gold and silver.
OTC derivatives remain poorly regulated, enabling Enron-style hidden balance-sheet abuses, now in AI/crypto.
US government investments (Intel, Venezuelan gold, steel mills) without business plans are a worrying drift toward state-run business.
